        'stats|--save-baseline' = 'Save the report as this baseline instead of printing it.'
        'stats|--compare' = 'Print the change against this saved baseline.'
        'stats|--calibrate' = 'Fit [estimator] chars per token with Anthropic''s count_tokens (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).'
        'stats|--cache' = 'Prompt-cache health per session from the proxy''s usage rows.'
        'stats|--price' = 'Add the cost of the proxy''s usage rows at [stats.prices].'
        'stats|--config' = 'The config file to use instead of ~/.rtok/config.toml.'
        'stats|-h' = 'Show help.'
        'stats|--help' = 'Show help.'
        'stats|--version' = 'Show version.'
    }
    $cmd = ''
    $skip = $false
    foreach ($element in ($commandAst.CommandElements | Select-Object -Skip 1)) {
        if ($element.Extent.EndOffset -ge $cursorPosition) { break }
        $word = $element.ToString()
        if ($skip) {
            $skip = $false
        } elseif ($word.StartsWith('-')) {
            $skip = $values -contains "$cmd|$word"
        } elseif ($children[$cmd] -contains $word) {
            $cmd = "$cmd $word".Trim()
        }
    }
    if ($skip) { return }
    $list = if ($wordToComplete.StartsWith('-')) { $options[$cmd] } else { $children[$cmd] }
    foreach ($item in $list) {
        if ($item.StartsWith($wordToComplete, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)) {
            $hint = $hints["$cmd|$item"]
            if (-not $hint) { $hint = $item }
            [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($item, $item, 'ParameterValue', $hint)
        }
    }
}
